content.title: Information We Collect
content.description: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you schedule an appointment, fill out forms, or contact us. This may include your name, contact information, medical history, insurance information, and other health-related data necessary for providing eye care services.

content.title: How We Use Your Information
content.description: We use your personal information to provide, maintain, and improve our eye care services, process appointments, communicate with you about your care, process insurance claims, and comply with legal obligations. We may also use your information to send you appointment reminders and important health information.

content.title: Information Sharing and Disclosure
content.description: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information with healthcare providers involved in your care, insurance companies for claims processing, and as required by law. All sharing is done in compliance with HIPAA and other applicable privacy laws.

content.title: Data Security
content.description: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. This includes secure data storage, encrypted communications, and restricted access to patient information.

content.title: Your Rights
content.description: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. You may also request a copy of your medical records or restrict certain uses of your information. To exercise these rights, please contact our office directly.

content.title: Contact Information
content.description: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at sehtvision@gmail.com or call +256 760 526 155. We are committed to addressing your privacy concerns promptly and professionally.
